title: A Colony for the Protocol Again
author: A. M. Yarrow
blurb: Quentin Crane, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
